key_insight: Muses is the first training-free, feed-forward system that composes and generates diverse, coherent fantasy 3D creatures by using an explicit 3D skeleton as the primary scaffold for design and synthesis.
problem_solved: It overcomes unrealistic or incoherent 3D assets produced by part-level optimization, manual assembly, or 2D-to-3D pipelines, enabling plausible out-of-domain creature designs without dataset training or laborious tuning.
method: Use an explicit 3D skeleton as a canonical scaffold to define anatomy, articulation, and part placement for creature designs.
Feed-forward, training-free composition pipeline that assembles and blends parts around the skeleton, then refines geometry and topology for coherence.
Apply skeleton-driven constraints and shape refinement to enforce anatomical plausibility and consistent articulation across generated creatures.
impact: Muses lowers the barrier to rapid, diverse 3D creature creation without collecting/training on large datasets or manual assembly, accelerating asset generation for research, games, and creative tools.

paper_title: Muses: Designing, Composing, Generating Nonexistent Fantasy 3D Creatures without Training
paper_authors: Hexiao Lu, Xiaokun Sun, Zeyu Cai, Hao Guo, Ying Tai
